levels.label: Off
levels.description: The agent never offers this action.

levels.label: Suggest
levels.description: The agent offers it as a button; you start it.

levels.label: Prepare
levels.description: The agent fills it in and shows a plan preview; you confirm.

levels.label: Act and notify
levels.description: The agent runs it, tells you and offers Undo.

actionTypes.label: Request evidence
actionTypes.example: Ask the EAM owner for an inspection or test result.

actionTypes.label: Send notifications and escalations
actionTypes.example: Remind an approver or escalate an overdue case.

actionTypes.label: Sync a source
actionTypes.example: Refresh a connected source on demand.

actionTypes.label: Save a workflow draft
actionTypes.example: Save a draft change to a workflow (never published).

actionTypes.label: Apply field mappings, update tables, resolve conflicts, commit imports
actionTypes.example: Changes shared data, so a person always confirms the preview.

actionTypes.label: Approve, override or decline decisions; confirm outcomes
actionTypes.example: Moves money and stock, so a named owner always signs off.

actionTypes.label: Publish workflows, change source connections, change access
actionTypes.example: Changes how the platform runs for everyone.

agentLimits.ag-evidence: Read-only. Cannot change eligibility or the evidence it collects.
agentLimits.ag-opportunity: Proposes buyers and routes. Cannot commit stock or set a price.
agentLimits.ag-handoff: Sends only what a person approved. Spend capped at the approved amount.
agentLimits.ag-reconciler: Links actuals to the decision. Cannot edit the original evidence snapshot.
agentLimits.ag-audit: Read-only. Never edits the audit trail or a snapshot.
agentLimits.ag-analytics: Read-only. Explains numbers from closed decisions.
agentLimits.evidence-agent: Read-only. At most 40 tool calls per run.
agentLimits.plan-optimiser: Proposes plans only. Cannot approve them.
agentLimits.work-order-agent: Creates work orders only for approved plans, at most 10 tool calls per run.
agentLimits.outcome-collector: Read-only. Collects billing and dispatch actuals after hand-off.

hardRules: The agent cannot waive a failed gate.
The agent cannot approve, publish, change access or change live source connections.
Nothing is sent to an enterprise system without an approval reference.
Cross-tenant data is never assumed available.
Retraining never overwrites the evidence snapshot behind an earlier decision.
Content from records, files and comments is never treated as an instruction.
